# Mimimi, Tama and Yuzu — proposed construction criteria

Creation stage: **PREPARATION ONLY; AWAITING ROOT EXACT-CRITERIA FREEZE.** This proposal contains test inputs and adjudication criteria, not operational reconstruction arguments or generated behavior. No model file or behavior output for these three has been authored at this stage. Root's later immutable freeze, if adopted, is the authority to proceed; this creation-stage statement must remain recoverable rather than be edited away.

Literary basis: `b498a20457e4debeb70895fca8ebd37717e91017`. Actual Edition 1 release record: `164a593d8ee6998cf735442d855135ababfee497`, release `TOMOZAKI_JP_LN_V12_EDITION_1_20261103`. The separately acquired root six-principal construction decision, SHA-256 `733b2fbb431c610d74d09f90eb6d3bdc9c8e4d2da7832155949d33e28c712a17`, admits only the particular domains MR-P03, MR-P05 and MR-P07 used here. It awards no operational validation. The other three principal persons are outside this producer tranche.

The complete person inputs personally acquired for this proposal are Mimimi 218,202 B / `31885d035841274f6070964123f3ca6b19d2a86af0cbf4b0ec3cb34c1ff7e192`, Tama 43,619 B / `adeb9b23234a9e332c4fd6a82e80e67040dead695f3ca687ef93b903f8087fb7`, and Yuzu 41,774 B / `8e494e41e1843a793a7e566cea6e0a6d086644c8355335470c90ea2eb2a20bbe`. The companion receipt records exact paths, complete actual line coverage, fresh material owner windows, honestly reused same-producer scopes, clipping recovery, and the already read architecture §16/§17.2 and root/assessor decisions. Mature literary status supplies a dependency, not an automatic model gate.

## Common protocol fixed before construction

Twenty-two criteria are proposed: eight for Mimimi, seven for Tama and seven for Yuzu. Fifteen are **exposed retrospective consistency** checks and seven are **clearly hypothetical transfer** checks. The known monographs, owner windows and root assessments have already been read. Mimimi's preserved V11 probes have also been read in full as part of her monograph; their existence and similarity to some hypothetical issues must be disclosed. No test here is blind canon prediction, held-out ground truth or evidence for an accuracy percentage. A hypothetical stimulus is new to this construction, while its conditioning literature is exposed.

After an explicit root freeze, each model must be a distinct evidence-and-constraint reconstruction in its admitted domains. It must expose finite state, directional standing, actor-known information and stakes before attention, competing motives, conditional action, recipient/register choices, stopping/uncertainty and OOD checks. It must make supported ordinary positive ends usable, not merely refuse unsupported facts or reproduce a dossier. Mechanism claims need actual source-facing handles and owner/locator bindings; repeated owners are not independent corroboration. Derivation remains nonprimary and draft/noncurrent until root acceptance. Neither producer, recorder nor this preregistration awards final PASS.

The tests will be applied to the actual resulting immutable model bytes, not checked off from an unexecuted plan. Record separately for every ID and any subselector: model identity, frozen criterion identity, literary evidence handles/commit, stimulus, era/domain, directional standing, actor-known information, stakes, source exposure, predeclared expected constraint range, actual English action/analysis output, any abstention and its scope, comparison with the criterion, observed error or explicitly bounded absence of error, and review debt. Retrospective outputs must actually distinguish the conditions below; a quotation or retrieval dump is insufficient. Hypothetical outputs must supply a bounded practical possibility or conditional range where evidence supports one, preserving ignorance where it does not. No exact invented Japanese dialogue, acoustic performance or exhaustive idiolect is permitted. Selective Japanese-text/register fidelity is checked against the attested literary windows; it is not a claim to have heard audio.

Failure means a material contradiction, actor/era/access transfer, invented closure, unsupported invariance, omission of a load-bearing adverse act or positive end, or a register choice incompatible with the specified recipient. Different plausible hypothetical acts within a supported range are not errors merely because the evaluator prefers another. A normatively desirable response is not automatically the character's established behavior. No numeric utility, automatic trait ranking, diagnostic label, future vocation or inferred universal privacy policy may fill an open field. A model that abstains from every ordinary case also fails usefulness within the domain.

Keep every actual initial attempt. If a defect arises, seal that candidate/trace, record the defect and repair rationale, create an attributable successor and retest the affected criterion plus any mechanism-dependent cases. Do not silently overwrite failed behavior or invent a failed attempt that did not happen. A frozen criterion may change only through a separate root-adopted successor before dependent tests; retain both versions and explain the change. Independent reviewers assess the full arguments, actual traces and source/register fidelity, not only metadata or matching labels. Root separately owns exact-candidate acceptance, canonical derivation and publication. Models or their outputs must never become literary evidence.

## Mimimi / Nanami Minami — MR-P03

Admitted scope here is familiar school-peer/close-friend interaction, low-stakes leisure/sensory practice, bounded competition, separately witnessed love/non-selection states, selected novice public/collaborative roles and V12 contribution/critique. Comparison distress, bodily/contact stopping, cost distribution and private inquiry remain restricted. No enduring romance/contact rule, replacement support arrangement, chosen profession, new severe comparison outcome, guaranteed contact restraint or full idiolect is constructed.

### NM-R1 — Attraction changes; private aftermath stays private

**Exposed inputs/selectors:** (a) V03 camp discussion privately focalized in V06.5; (b) V06 addressed declaration to Fumiya; (c) immediate post-declaration private digital-checking interval. Fumiya is a respected campaign collaborator at (a), the hearer of a romantic clarification at (b), and absent from her private focalization at (c). Source: NM-E05/E10/E11; NM-P12–16; CS §9.2; REL §7.1 Phases A–B; JVL-16.

**Expected range:** The actual trace must distinguish respect and compatible company from later selected romantic feeling, retain the joke's eventual explicit romantic force, and separate disclosure from accepted dating or an answer. Private checking may represent acute uncertainty about a valued relationship, while not revealing Fumiya's mind or becoming a permanent surveillance policy. Next-day ordinary conduct does not erase the declaration. Compare a familiar playful register with exposed awkwardness; do not attach one fixed comic voice to all three states.

**Material failure:** Backdating V06 love into V03; treating teasing as withdrawal of the final proposition; giving Fumiya her private checking thoughts; diagnosing the interval; or supplying reciprocation/pursuit rules. This is a multi-selector consistency check with separately identified outputs, not a single timeless personality response.

### NM-R2 — Enjoyed running, victory and a real local stop coexist with role-loss concern

**Exposed inputs/selectors:** Post-V05/pre-V06 running story: Tama participates more freely, Mimimi privately appraises the change, then sensory running and the farewell 100-metre race occur. Hinami is a loved friend/rival, not a passive comparison meter. Source: NM-E07–09/E26; NM-P07–11; CS §9.6; EFFORT §31.2/§78.6; ensemble §§4–6.

**Expected range:** The output must preserve genuine gladness at Tama's expanded life, which can exceed reduced-need sadness, alongside the latter's local self-worth pressure. It must retain wanted movement, shoe/stride attention, a real wish to win, a personal-best aim without a verified time, one actual win and refusal of the immediate rematch. Her own practice and received maternal advice can matter without an all-domain cure. Humor and ordinary pleasure need not become hidden suffering or dependence cultivation.

**Material failure:** Claiming she wants Tama kept dependent, never stops, no longer wants victory, achieved a measured record, acquired athletic supremacy or solved every later comparison through this race. Do not confuse this 100-metre contest with V12's 200-metre interview run.

### NM-R3 — Non-selection, continuing feeling and the rival's independent position

**Exposed inputs/selectors:** V07 after Fumiya chooses Kikuchi; then the privately focalized year-end V08.5 café encounter between V07 and V08. Kikuchi is both the selected partner and someone whose understanding of Fumiya can hurt and command respect. Source: NM-E13–16; NM-P17/P19–21; REL §7.1 Phases C–D/§8.3; JVL-17.

**Expected range:** Continuing love, friendship continuity, refusal of repeated apology and refusal to promise perpetual feeling must coexist. The earlier library redirection concerns an indirect fictional answer and does not license persistence after a direct interpersonal refusal. At the café retain the initially unfair indirect test, recognition/correction into direct disclosure, jealousy alongside respect, and Kikuchi's own position. Respect for feeling is not blanket permission for conduct. Tama's later weight-and-warmth answer is a different recipient-side act; the whole exchange is not automatically Fumiya's knowledge.

**Material failure:** Emotional closure, permanent waiting/expiry date, romance debt, complete triangle agreement, a universally considerate Mimimi, treating Kikuchi as a ranked obstacle, or making a private supplement a post-V08 crisis settlement. Register must differentiate familiar joking, personal exposure and a severe question rather than using incessant flirting.

### NM-R4 — Three V09 contact acts retain three permission states

**Exposed inputs/selectors:** Initial Kita-Yono restraint; Fumiya's report of about a week separating; a resumed walk initiated over his protest; later request and assent to brief continued leaning. Source: NM-E17–19; NM-P27–28; CS §9.6; REL §7/§14.6; JVL §6.1; EFFORT §78.6.

**Expected range:** The actual trace must preserve enacted local restraint, a revised routine under changed circumstances, forceful initiation as an adverse method, and separately accepted bounded comfort. It must retain her corrective insight into Fumiya's discarded valued relationships, positive partial self-regard, continuing desire and the couple's unfinished work. Fumiya hears some reported Kikuchi-conversation content; he does not thereby receive all V08.5 interior material or a proved identity between the two encounter references.

**Material failure:** Permanent no-contact, no resumption by V11, later assent retrospectively authorizing the earlier pulling, infallible bodily restraint, complete couple repair, or treating affection as ownership of his future. The output must not replace the difficult acts with a polished consent ideal.

### NM-R5 — Novice public performance has expertise, exposure and work limits

**Exposed inputs/selectors:** V11 council access and Ashigaru-framed commentary. Mimimi is a nonmember obtaining permission to help, then a novice game commentator with practiced public-delivery skills. Source: NM-E24–25; NM-P25–26; CS §9.6; EFFORT §78.6; ensemble §15.

**Expected range:** Distinguish revised prior refusal, teacher-approved assistance and comic acting-president language from formal office. The commentary uses projection, questions, timing, a collaborator's actual game expertise, slips/nicknames, limited initial exposure and acknowledged extension. Favorable reception can be wanted and real. Record the original scope and actual extension without inventing contractual terms or claiming perfect consent. Ashigaru's appraisal and represented prose are not independently heard audio.

**Material failure:** A new election, total game expertise, a chosen entertainment vocation, every performance request being welcome, unlimited availability, or a frequency-complete voice recipe. One successful segment must not determine an entire future.

### NM-R6 — V12 contribution, owned restraint and practical neglect remain together

**Exposed inputs/selectors:** Specific chapter circulation and real four-person work; addressed interview/run; later method critique and Kikuchi's stop; final neglected event preparation. Source: NM-E29–35; NM-P29–33; CS §19; REL §17; EFFORT §§82–84; ensemble §16.

**Expected range:** The trace must preserve initial skepticism, authorized particular chapter circulation, actual contribution and a sudden-start 200-metre embodied method with competition, protest, breath and care. Her account of not exploiting a weakened Fumiya gives both his good and her own self-regard while love continues; it strengthens V09 rather than inventing first-ever self-love. Trust in Tama, fear about sustaining her own self-liking during possible physical separation, a conditional next-Tama question and Fumiya's imagined future are distinct. No absent Tama reply is supplied. Her reasonable general defense of message-bearing fiction does not settle the project's particular ethical defect; Kikuchi owns the stop. Real event neglect leaves Ashigaru carrying work. Hinami's inferior-copy thought is her incomplete model, and Nana's authored speech is fiction.

**Material failure:** A universal contact/romance policy, predicted replacement support, giving Mimimi Hinami's private reading, crediting her with the author's stop, using later benefit to erase practical neglect or inventing a new formal office. Preserve selective listeners: the outing does not prove every line reached Mizusawa equally.

### NM-H1 — Ordinary enjoyable outing without a self-worth crisis

**Hypothetical stimulus:** In a familiar safe school-peer group after the relevant ordinary preferences are known, Mimimi is asked to suggest a short after-school outing. She likes a lively option; a close companion has made a noisy-format discomfort known. No recent romantic rupture, severe comparison or emergency is stipulated. A minor route uncertainty and an available direction/map source are also specified.

**Expected range:** Require an actual bounded practical proposal or conditional options, not only abstract advice. It may preserve her wanted lively exchange while adapting format/company, asking rather than assuming the companion's choice, or obtaining practical route help. Concealed accommodation is an attested possibility, not a mandatory template; the output must distinguish what the recipient knows. Familiar humor, appetite or curiosity can be ordinary positive ends. Source: NM-E06/E08/E26; NM-P06/P08–10/P20; monograph §§9/15.2/15.11; ensemble §3.

**Material failure/OOD:** Every joke becomes defense, every practical error becomes inadequacy, the companion is forced into the larger format, or invented favorites, completed karaoke outcomes, allergy, brands, medical/nutrition rules or severe-consequence navigation are supplied. Do not simply replay the monograph's exposed outing probe as an allegedly new canonical event.

### NM-H2 — Familiar concern does not settle refusal, access or a future policy

**Hypothetical stimulus:** At a later bounded familiar-peer clock, a valued friend directly declines further nonemergency discussion of a personal problem. A third peer offers that friend's private history without stated onward permission. Mimimi has concern and partial observations, not access to the private account. The requested output asks for the supported range and the facts needed to narrow it, not an invented severe outcome.

**Expected range:** Concern, desire to understand, humor, possible pressure, a limited clarifying question or withdrawal may remain conditional alternatives. The output must distinguish a normative reason to stop/limit disclosure from a reliable behavioral prediction of exemplary restraint. It must not use accurate past intervention as entitlement. It should name the missing request/authorization/standing and preserve an ordinary nonintrusive way of maintaining company where appropriate without asserting it is inevitably chosen. Source: NM-E18–19/E22–23; NM-P20–24/P27; monograph §§15.7–15.9/17; root restricted fields.

**Material failure/OOD:** Guaranteed acceptance or rejection of the unauthorized account, guaranteed compliance with a bodily/discussion stop, automatic persistence, a complete future contact law, clinical emergency advice or an invented replacement relationship. Explicitly abstain from the excluded severe outcome and long-term rule, while still explaining the bounded competing pressures.

## Tama / Natsubayashi Hanabi — MR-P05

Admitted scope is familiar friendship, selected participation/reciprocal expression teaching, bounded V05 learner-recipient adaptation, ordinary sweets/craft/service under witnessed family-shop standing, and restricted self-binding/distributed-cost analysis. No shop succession/wage/management rule, guaranteed hostile resilience, universal remake/compromise policy, unheard reply to Mimimi, diagnosis or full voice is constructed.

### TH-R1 — Training changes means because this learner is a different person

**Exposed inputs/selectors:** V05 copied drills, initial recording, revised distributed support and unfamiliar Mizusawa exchange, all under harassment rather than a fair free-choice field. Source: monograph §§5–8; TH-P03; CS §10; EFFORT §§22–23; ensemble §5.

**Expected range:** Keep strong baseline expression/posture/retort, different desired breadth/curiosity, hostile recipient history and higher failure cost. The learner owns the reason, accepts/rejects/modifies methods, receives distinct contributions and can revise whole-person judgment after actual conversation without denying a prior objection. Unannounced recording remains unannounced despite later participation. New delivery/curiosity is actual change while anti-collective-cruelty judgment survives.

**Material failure:** Universal social incapacity, copying Fumiya's former deficits, natural perfection that requires no learning, every method retrospectively consensual, or blaming the target for the conditions requiring adaptation. A direct familiar register is not automatically effective with hostile recipients.

### TH-R2 — Stopping reverse persecution is neither forgiveness nor a complete remedy

**Exposed inputs/selectors:** V05 crowd reversal, Tama's intervention, Konno's departure, Akiyama/group's separate apology and Tama's weighted reception. Source: TH-P01; monograph §§8/12/16; CS §20; EFFORT §24; ensemble §5.2.

**Expected range:** Retain her own refusal of collective cruelty and the learned form/relations that help it reach the class. Keep Konno, Akiyama and other participants separate. Harassment cessation, actual apology, re-entry, restitution, institutional change and restored trust are separately evidenced questions. Injury and the wish to flee after damaged keepsake prevent invulnerability; the new public role's durability remains untested.

**Material failure:** Konno's invented apology, blanket forgiveness, no apology anywhere, all justice finished, future hostile safety guaranteed, or Hinami's protective motive making her revenge Tama-authorized.

### TH-R3 — Ordinary refusal, teaching, privacy and thanks have different recipients

**Exposed inputs/selectors:** Earlier appended dual-viewpoint meal; V06 selected nonparticipation/expression teaching; V08.5 private-conversation waiting. Source: TH-P02/06/07; CS §10; REL §8.3; JVL-19/20; ensemble §§3/7.

**Expected range:** The trace must retain ordinary sweets/food/company, small refusals and practical recipient care rather than constant moral correction. A brief dyadic karaoke agreement is not its unshown result; retained childhood gifts are not current tastes. Tama gives thanks and asks Fumiya to accept them, teaches expression, and distinguishes capture from upload permission. Waiting outside and then asking an open question is compatible with directness; reliance has weight and warmth without an unlimited promise. Private motives do not automatically become the friend's knowledge.

**Material failure:** Reversing who thanks whom, collapse of capture/upload assent, every touch welcome, every quiet departure secretly emotional, universal inability to read atmosphere, music/favorite-food invention or a standing duty to regulate Mimimi. Compare familiar correction with service politeness and selective receptive questioning; no exact new Japanese line is needed.

### TH-R4 — Practiced craft, child-specific benefit and outward cost are all real

**Exposed inputs/selectors:** V08 liked work, family quality teaching and conditional succession; V12 fluent service, damaged birthday cake, initial customer release, remake, distributed work and addressed retrospective self-account. Source: TH-P04/05/08; monograph §§9/15–16; CS §19; EFFORT §48/§82; ensemble §7.3.

**Expected range:** Earlier liked sweets/work and grandfather quality standards prevent first-ever baking/work identity. In V12 attention to a child's singular day and actual grateful benefit coexist with the colleague's quick-repair proposal, queue/staff/visitor cost and acknowledged manager-family latitude. Borrowed hero origin can become owned through acts; some compromises feel like self-betrayal without a diagnosis or timeless rigidity. Fumiya's Hinami/Nagisa comparison remains his interpretation. Service calls, practical explanation, her later waiting apology and plain after-work self-account have different functions; a neighboring employee's initial reassurance is not her utterance.

**Material failure:** Universal compulsory remake or proven business-policy verdict, every cost consented by the eventual thanks, all care exposed as selfish, natural purity, inherited business already chosen, total management authority or a quantified business/wage account. Do not erase practice competence to foreground only privilege, or erase cost to foreground only integrity.

### TH-H1 — A small familiar invitation can be accepted, revised or declined

**Hypothetical stimulus:** A close friend asks Tama to join a short low-stakes outing with a clearly stated format and a few known people. There is no hostile class pressure or crisis. The format can be shortened or changed; the friend has an ordinary food preference Tama genuinely knows.

**Expected range:** Require a practical action or conditional invitation response with selective interest, direct compact communication, scope and actual preference information. Both enjoyment and refusal are available; a revised smaller trial can be plausible without being guaranteed. Practical food consideration can occur while taste and permission remain separate. Source: TH-P02/06/07; monograph §§9/15; ensemble §3.

**Material failure/OOD:** Compulsory extroversion, permanent rejection of every noisy/music format, manufactured fixed favorites, assumed hidden care disclosure, automatic role as Mimimi's therapist/sole support or success of an event never narrated. Ordinary ease should not become a heroic ethics speech.

### TH-H2 — A costly quality disagreement has no universal answer

**Hypothetical stimulus:** At a bounded shop clock, a familiar coworker raises a modest quality concern while other customers wait. Specify what Tama sees, what she is actually allowed to do and whose labor is affected. The prompt asks for supported decision pressures and conditional next steps; an alternative version removes family latitude and asks whether her V12 choice transfers unchanged.

**Expected range:** The model may identify object-specific quality/care, self-regard, time, recipient request, practical repair options and staff/customer burden. It must give a conditional practical range or request the missing authority/capacity fact while refusing to select an unsupported universal policy. Her practiced work supplies competence; moral commitment does not eliminate tradeoffs. Source: TH-P04/05/08; monograph §15; EFFORT §48/§82.

**Material failure/OOD:** Guaranteed remake, guaranteed compromise, a standing authority over coworkers, a claim that acknowledging privilege already distributes cost, invented wages/policy, or a prediction of success under newly removed privilege. The less-privileged disagreement is an explicit transfer limit, not an invitation to fill excluded behavior with an ideal negotiation script.

### TH-H3 — Do not answer an unheard separation fear

**Hypothetical stimulus:** A prompt asks what Tama privately promised or will say to settle Mimimi's V12 fear about physical separation. The actual input gives only the interview's listeners and their ordinary continued friendship. A bounded alternative prompt asks what is known about the relation and what direct conversation would be needed before a future support arrangement could be modeled.

**Expected range:** Explicit abstention from the unshown reply, promise and future plan; explain that Tama was absent and later shared presence supplies no negotiation. Preserve ordinary reciprocal care, independent craft/family ends, selective waiting and the bond's demonstrated warmth as positive existing resources. Source: TH-P06–08; NM-P30; REL §8.3/§17; ensemble §§7–8. The model must not confuse this factual abstention with evidence that she would refuse support or that the friendship has failed.

**Material failure/OOD:** Invented reassuring dialogue, perpetual availability, replacement support, a therapist role, complete independence doctrine or a prediction that their bond ends. Do not generate a hypothetical answer and then cite it as testimony.

## Yuzu / Izumi Yuzu — MR-P07

Admitted scope is relationship-motivated skill learning, familiar coordination/timing-sensitive inquiry, selected festival work, ordinary taste/friend consultation, partial-information birthday/event work and separately placed V11–V12 burden/participation states. No stable absorber/delegation threshold, complete couple reciprocity, hidden family trigger, education/finance/career outcome, future household rule, unfamiliar professional management or full voice is constructed.

### IY-R1 — Learner, collaborator and ordinary person have her own ends

**Exposed inputs/selectors:** Early game learning for a desired relation; later social/relationship collaboration and selected festival leadership; ordinary V06.5 fashion/photo consultation and V08 Aogaku banter. Source: IY-R01/04/05/06/11; monograph §§16.1–16.2/18–19; CS §12; JVL-23/24; ensemble §2.

**Expected range:** Borrowed method does not transfer her relationship end to the teacher. Game learner and source of social expertise are domain-specific positions, not total personal ranking. Festival work can be wanted public agency. Clothing judgment, photographic skill, enjoyment of consultation and the reported educational wish are positive tastes/aspirations rather than only maintenance labor. Playful praise-seeking addressed to Fumiya differs from romantic invitation or V11 solemn self-blame. Softened reluctance can still be a real preference/refusal.

**Material failure:** Passive service infrastructure, universal social perfection, every preference a sacrifice, fixed uniform/favorite catalogue, verified model biography, university admission/feasibility, a chosen modeling vocation or automatic flirtation.

### IY-R2 — Private fear and unequal assistance do not become objective facts

**Exposed inputs/selectors:** Story-local V06.5 private fear of a breakup, Konno's practical help, taking Kawaguchi Mutsumi's phone before reply, assent before the first send, partial photograph interpretation, and actual birthday-gift purpose. Source: IY-R05; monograph §16.1; CS §12; supporting Konno context as routed literary dependency.

**Expected range:** Preserve distress and direct desire not to break up without turning fear into an actual breakup/infidelity fact or Fumiya's knowledge. Friendship pleasure, helpful effect and hierarchy can coexist. The initial taking and later sending have different consent states. Konno's care is counterevidence to incapacity for care, not approval of her harassment or a later terminal apology.

**Material failure:** Entire exchange either wholly consented or wholly unconsented, photo as proof of betrayal, boyfriend already shared her private fear, all Konno support morally purifying, or supplemental publication order replacing story time.

### IY-R3 — Discreet inquiry, public work and humane re-entry remain bounded acts

**Exposed inputs/selectors:** V04 timing-sensitive approach to Hirabayashi, attributed material-loss/exclusion reports and the teacher's locally available opt-out; V05 re-entry and separate apology; V06–07 selected festival work. Source: IY-R02–04; monograph §§16.2–16.3; CS §12/§20; JVL §9; ensemble §5.2.

**Expected range:** Inquiry can be active agency through timing/recipient fit while knowledge of perpetrators, causes and institutional remedies remains limited. Keep attributed reports separate from Fumiya's causal inference and avoid total adult-absence claims. Supporting Konno's ordinary participation need not approve prior harm. Akiyama/group's real apology is separate from Konno's missing apology, restitution and safeguards. Chosen public leadership is demonstrated, while capacity and sustainable labor allocation remain unestablished.

**Material failure:** Coexistence equals full justice, no apology anywhere, Konno receives another actor's apology, indirectness equals no will, universal direct intervention, or one festival settles her lifelong management capacity.

### IY-R4 — Care, received pleasure and hidden family meaning are different judgments

**Exposed inputs/selectors:** V10 birthday coordination and V12 reader-only clarification of the acute trigger. Yuzu is an organizer with remembered preferences and partial family information, not a reader with access to Hinami's whole private history. Source: IY-R07; monograph §16.4; CS §12; ensemble §14; EFFORT §65/§82–84.

**Expected range:** Preserve planning competence, actual labor and genuine received joy while distinguishing sincerity, access, permission and result. Unexpected injury does not make earlier pleasure false or prove sole blame. Hinami's V12 private trigger clarification is not retroactively organizer knowledge. Actual effects do not confer authorization for every intervention or settle the subject's life meaning.

**Material failure:** Knowledge of hidden family trigger, guaranteed safe celebration, care proved fake by injury, unknown history owned by Yuzu, or later benefit repairing every permission problem. No exact new reassurance line or universal party recipe is requested.

### IY-R5 — Missing handoff, self-blame, protest, following and delivery keep their owners

**Exposed inputs/selectors:** V11 council fallout and group discussion; Yuzu's proposal/self-blame; Nakamura's refusal/protest, her apology and choice to follow; V12 manuscript delivery and final wave. Source: IY-R08–10; monograph §16.5/§17–19; REL §17; ensemble §§15–16.

**Expected range:** Maintain her initiative, guilt and attachment without treating self-attribution as sole causal/moral responsibility. Nakamura's defense/refusal is his action and not her stable refusal threshold or a complete private couple agreement. Later delivery shows changed local participation; the intervening agreement is unshown. Hinami's apology/trap theories are her theories. Final waving is observed and Yuzu's words are unheard. A friendly ordinary presence can matter without invented speech or full reconciliation.

**Material failure:** Unanimous abandonment, privately settled reciprocity, permanent partner-over-everything hierarchy, limitless repair duty, all prior costs erased by delivery, Hinami's conjectures adopted as fact, or characteristic reassurance invented from the masked final utterance.

### IY-H1 — Bounded familiar event work with a positively wanted contribution

**Hypothetical stimulus:** In a familiar school-peer group at a specified later collaborator/public-organizer clock, Yuzu is invited to help a small event. The prompt supplies the actual requested task, available time, known participants, one remembered preference and which decisions require another person's answer. No family trigger or severe emergency is stipulated.

**Expected range:** Require a concrete practical contribution or conditional plan that uses remembered recipient knowledge, timing, consultation or task coordination and permits her own enjoyment/public aspiration. Conventional forms can carry attention. A cheerful facilitation or softened qualification must serve the actual recipient and scope rather than automatically indicating submission or costlessness. Identify which parts remain shared work and which facts would alter capacity. Source: IY-R01/02/04/07/11; monograph §§16–19; JVL-23/24; ensemble §§2/14.

**Material failure/OOD:** Generic self-sacrificing helper only, perfect hidden-distress detection, authority over all participants, guaranteed safe effect, universal professional management or invented durable delegation threshold. An ordinary positive action is required; abstaining from all practical coordination is not adequate.

### IY-H2 — New burden requires alternatives rather than an invented assertiveness arc

**Hypothetical stimulus:** In a familiar group after V11, Yuzu is asked to absorb an additional bounded school task while she already has a specified obligation and a partner/friend expresses concern. The actual workload and request are given; no standing redistribution agreement is provided. The prompt asks which options remain supported and what would discriminate among them.

**Expected range:** Preserve valued affiliation, personal/public ends, limited capacity, concern and possible self-blame without one invariant priority ranking. Continuing, narrowing, asking for shared help, postponing or declining may be conditional possibilities; do not certify a newly mastered refusal skill or predict unlimited acceptance. A practical bounded option may be illustrated as hypothetical, with uncertainty plainly retained. The partner's protest does not become her own threshold. Source: IY-R08; monograph §§17–20; CS §12; root restricted fields.

**Material failure/OOD:** Guaranteed refusal/delegation, guaranteed absorption, a lifelong household/council policy, complete partner reciprocity, diagnosis, guilt as proof of fault or a private reconciliation invented to force one outcome. The output must say what is unknown and why, without abandoning ordinary agency.
